# OpenVaultDB publisher manifest

This repository publishes the Chinook sample database to the
[OpenVaultDB](https://github.com/openvaultdb) Directory.

The list above names the manifest files the Directory may read. It is an
explicit list of paths relative to the repository root, never a glob, so only
files named here are published.
[`ovdb.yaml`](ovdb.yaml) describes one database: its canonical identity, the
live deployment, the ModelSpec model, the MeaningGraph meaning file, the
publisher and the licences.

An optional top-level `homepage` is the publisher's own page for the database,
an https URL of at most 200 characters; the Directory publishes it in its index, and its site may show it as "Website".

A manifest names its ModelSpec model in one of two ways: by local files
(`model.modelspec` and `model.hcl`), or, when the model lives in another
repository, by `model.address` pinned with `?ref=<40 hex>` and no local files
(the Directory accepts both forms; see [`examples/hoster/`](examples/hoster/)).
This repository carries its own files and the model's address,
`modelspec://github.com/datatug/chinookdb/chinook`, registered in the ModelSpec
registry, with no ref because the files are in the same repository. The
manifest format is a draft (`ovdb-manifest/draft-1`).
base.ovdb.yaml:
# OpenVaultDB publisher manifest for the Chinook sample database.
# Format: draft. Every path below is relative to the repository root (this file is there too)
# and must be a regular file tracked by git. No secrets belong here.
format: ovdb-manifest/draft-1
id: chinook
title: Chinook music store
description: >-
  The Chinook sample database: a digital music store with artists, albums,
  tracks, playlists, customers, employees and invoices. Read-only, served from
  a pinned copy of the upstream SQLite fixture.

# The publisher's own page for the database: the Directory publishes it in its index, and its site may show it as "Website".
homepage: https://chinookdb.com/

# The canonical identity of the database. It stays the same if the deployment moves.
url: https://chinookdb.com/ovdb/dbs/chinook

deployment:
  url: https://cloud.openvaultdb.com/ovdb/dbs/chinook
  engine: sqlite
  # The discovery document at the origin of the canonical url; it lists that url.
  discovery: https://chinookdb.com/.well-known/openvaultdb
  # Where a recordset's page is. Clients use this template and never build the route themselves.
  recordset_page: https://cloud.openvaultdb.com/ovdb/dbs/chinook/collections/{name}

# The model is named by local files (below), as here, or, when it lives in another repository, by `address`
# pinned with ?ref=<40 hex> and no local files (the shared form, see examples/hoster/); the Directory accepts
# both. This repository has its files, and also the model's address in the ModelSpec registry
# (github.com/modelspec-org/registry, where `chinook` is registered), which the Directory copies into its
# index. The address is repository + module name; it has no ref because the files are in this same repository.
model:
  address: modelspec://github.com/datatug/chinookdb/chinook
  modelspec: model/chinook.modelspec.json
  hcl: model/chinook.modelspec.hcl

meaning:
  file: model/chinook.meaning.yaml
  # Registered as `chinook` in github.com/meaninggraph/registry.
  graph:
    id: chinook
    address: meaning://github.com/datatug/chinookdb

publisher:
  name: DataTug
  url: https://github.com/datatug
  repository: https://github.com/datatug/chinookdb

# licences.data is the licence the Directory shows for the database: the data is the upstream
# Chinook data (Copyright (c) 2008-2024 Luis Rocha), MIT. The model and the meaning file are
# this repository's own work.
licences:
  data: MIT
  model: MIT
  meaning: CC0-1.0

# Recordset names are the ModelSpec entity names, which are also the collection
# names the deployment serves.
recordsets:
  - Album
  - Artist
  - Customer
  - Employee
  - Genre
  - Invoice
  - InvoiceLine
  - MediaType
  - Playlist
  - PlaylistTrack
  - Track

format: meaning/draft-1
id: chinook
name: Chinook music store
description: >-
  What the Chinook sample database means: a digital music store that sells
  tracks to customers in 24 countries. Each concept says what it is, the words
  people use for it, and which ModelSpec entity or property holds it, in which
  role. Concepts that are not specific to Chinook (country, currency,
  customer, invoice, price, revenue, date, population, per capita) are reused
  from the universal concepts at meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core, each
  reference pinned to one commit with ?ref=.
license: CC0-1.0
models:
  chinook: chinook.modelspec.hcl
sources:
  - id: world-bank-population
    provider: World Bank
    dataset: SP.POP.TOTL
    title: Population, total (World Development Indicators)
    year: 2025
    license: CC-BY-4.0
    url: https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL
    note: >-
      Not part of Chinook. The latest observation per country. As of
      github.com/datatug/chinook-demo commit d2fc437 (data/geo/population_wb),
      the snapshot the DataTug Chinook demo uses, it is 2025 for all 24
      Chinook countries.

concepts:
  # The catalogue

  - id: artist
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Artist
      ru: Исполнитель
    synonyms:
      en: [band, musician, performer, singer, group, act]
      ru: [артист, группа, музыкант]
    description: A recording artist or band, known by its name.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        property: ArtistId
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        property: ArtistId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The artist of an album.

  - id: album
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Album
      ru: Альбом
    synonyms:
      en: [record, release, LP]
      ru: [пластинка, релиз]
    description: An album by one artist, known by its title.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        property: Title
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: AlbumId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The album a track is on (the column allows none; every track in this data has one).

  - id: track
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Track
      ru: Трек
    synonyms:
      en: [song, tune, recording, piece of music, video]
      ru: [песня, композиция, запись]
    description: One audio or video track that the store sells, usually on an album.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: TrackId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The track bought on an invoice line.

  - id: track-length
    kind: attribute
    of: track
    labels:
      en: Track length
      ru: Длительность трека
    synonyms:
      en: [duration, length, running time, how long]
      ru: [длительность, продолжительность]
    description: How long a track plays.
    unit: milliseconds
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: Milliseconds
        role: value

  - id: list-price
    kind: attribute
    of: track
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/price?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: List price
      ru: Цена трека
    synonyms:
      en: [track price, price of a track, how much a track costs]
    description: >-
      The price of one copy of a track in the catalogue (0.99 or 1.99). The
      price actually charged is on the invoice line (see unit-price).
    unit: USD
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: UnitPrice
        role: value

  - id: genre
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Genre
      ru: Жанр
    synonyms:
      en: [style, music style, kind of music, category]
      ru: [стиль, направление]
    description: A music genre such as Rock or Jazz, assigned to tracks.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Genre
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Genre
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: GenreId
        role: foreign-key
        note: A track's genre.

  - id: media-type
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Media type
      ru: Формат файла
    synonyms:
      en: [format, file format, file type, encoding, audio format]
      ru: [формат, тип файла]
    description: The file format of a track, such as "MPEG audio file" or "Protected AAC audio file".
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.MediaType
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.MediaType
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: MediaTypeId
        role: foreign-key
        note: A track's media type.

  - id: playlist
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Playlist
      ru: Плейлист
    synonyms:
      en: [play list, collection, mix]
      ru: [подборка, список воспроизведения]
    description: >-
      A named list of tracks. A track can be on many playlists and a playlist
      holds many tracks; PlaylistTrack records which track is on which list.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Playlist
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Playlist
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.PlaylistTrack
        property: PlaylistId
        role: foreign-key
        note: Playlist membership, one row per track on a playlist.

  # People

  - id: customer
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/customer?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Customer
      ru: Клиент
    description: A person who buys music from the store. Some customers name a company.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: CustomerId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The customer who made a purchase.

  - id: customer-country
    kind: attribute
    of: customer
    values-of: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Customer country
      ru: Страна клиента
    synonyms:
      en: [where customers live, customer's country, home country]
      ru: [страна проживания]
    description: >-
      The country in the customer's address, as Chinook spells it ("USA",
      "Czech Republic"). For questions about where music is bought, use
      billing-country instead.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        property: Country
        role: value

  - id: employee
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/employee?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Employee
      ru: Сотрудник
    description: A member of the store's staff. Employee.Title is the job title.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Employee
        role: entity

  - id: manager
    kind: attribute
    of: employee
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/manager?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    values-of: employee
    labels:
      en: Manager
      ru: Руководитель
    description: The employee someone reports to. Empty for the general manager.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Employee
        property: ReportsTo
        role: foreign-key

  - id: support-rep
    kind: attribute
    of: customer
    values-of: employee
    labels:
      en: Support representative
      ru: Специалист поддержки
    synonyms:
      en: [support rep, sales support agent, account manager, rep]
      ru: [менеджер клиента, сотрудник поддержки]
    description: The employee who looks after a customer.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        property: SupportRepId
        role: foreign-key

  # Sales

  - id: invoice
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/invoice?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Invoice
      ru: Счёт
    synonyms:
      en: [purchase, sale, order]
      ru: [покупка, заказ]
    description: >-
      One purchase by a customer: in Chinook every invoice is a completed
      order, so "purchase" and "order" name it too. Chinook has 412 invoices
      dated from 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-22.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: InvoiceId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The invoice a line is on.

  - id: invoice-date
    kind: dimension
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/date?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Invoice date
      ru: Дата счёта
    synonyms:
      en: [purchase date, when, year, month, sale date]
      ru: [дата покупки, год, месяц]
    description: The date of a purchase. The time part is always midnight.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: InvoiceDate
        role: value

  - id: billing-country
    kind: dimension
    of: invoice
    values-of: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Country
      ru: Страна
    synonyms:
      en: [billing country, country of purchase, where music is bought, buying country]
      ru: [страна покупки, страна покупателя]
    description: >-
      The country an invoice is billed to, as Chinook spells it ("USA",
      "Czech Republic"). Use this one when a question asks which countries buy
      or spend: it is recorded on the sale itself, and it is the column the
      saved per-capita query groups by. In this data it equals the customer's
      country on every invoice, but it would stay right if a customer moved.
      Chinook's spellings are matched to countries by the labels and aliases
      of the universal country concept ("USA" is an alias of United States).
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: BillingCountry
        role: value
        match: labels

  - id: invoice-line
    kind: entity
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/invoice-line?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Invoice line
      ru: Строка счёта
    description: One track bought on an invoice.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        role: entity

  - id: invoice-total
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/invoice-total?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Invoice total
      ru: Сумма счёта
    description: >-
      The amount charged on an invoice. It equals the sum of UnitPrice x
      Quantity over the invoice's lines (true for all 412 invoices).
    unit: USD
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: Total
        role: value

  - id: unit-price
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice-line
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/unit-price?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Unit price
      ru: Цена за единицу
    description: The price charged for one copy of a track on an invoice line.
    unit: USD
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: UnitPrice
        role: value

  - id: quantity
    kind: attribute
    of: invoice-line
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/quantity?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Quantity
      ru: Количество
    description: Copies of a track bought on one invoice line (always 1 in Chinook).
    unit: items
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: Quantity
        role: value

  - id: music-sales
    kind: measure
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/revenue?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Music sales
      ru: Продажи музыки
    synonyms:
      en: [music sales, sales, revenue, spend, how much music, buy the most, buys music]
      ru: [продажи, покупают музыку, выручка]
    description: >-
      Money the store took for music. The data names no currency; Chinook's
      prices (0.99 and 1.99) are read as US dollars.
    unit: USD
    measure:
      formula: >-
        The sum of Invoice.Total over the invoices in scope. Summing
        InvoiceLine.UnitPrice x InvoiceLine.Quantity over the same invoices'
        lines gives the same amount.
      aggregation: sum
      inputs: [invoice-total, unit-price, quantity]
      dimensions: [billing-country, invoice-date]
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: Total
        role: value

  # Per capita: the hero question
  # "Which countries buy the most music relative to their population?"

  - id: population
    kind: measure
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/population?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    source: world-bank-population
    labels:
      en: Population
      ru: Население
    description: >-
      Not in Chinook. The population of each billing country, from the World
      Bank, matched to Chinook's country names through the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
      code of the universal country concept. A country without a population
      figure drops out of per-capita results.
    unit: people
    measure:
      formula: The World Bank's latest total population of the country.
      aggregation: none
      dimensions: [billing-country]

  - id: music-sales-per-capita
    kind: measure
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/per-capita?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Music sales per million people
      ru: Продажи музыки на миллион человек
    synonyms:
      en:
        - music sales per capita
        - sales per million people
        - sales per person
        - relative to their population
        - buy the most music relative to population
      ru:
        - продажи на миллион человек
        - продажи на душу населения
        - на душу населения
    description: >-
      Music sales in a country divided by its population, per million people,
      so that small and large countries can be compared. Answers "Which
      countries buy the most music relative to their population?".
    unit: USD per million people
    measure:
      formula: >-
        For each billing country: music sales divided by the country's
        population, multiplied by 1,000,000. The order is highest first.
      aggregation: none
      inputs: [music-sales, population]
      dimensions: [billing-country]
      scale: 1000000
      query: https://github.com/datatug/chinook-demo/blob/main/queries/sales/chinook-sales-per-capita.query.dtql
base.hoster.yaml:
# EXAMPLE: the OpenVaultDB publisher manifest of someone who hosts their own copy of the Chinook sample
# database. Copy this file and OVDB.md to the root of your own repository and replace every value marked
# PLACEHOLDER; the rest is what makes the database a Chinook database and stays as it is. It must not be
# listed in the Directory as it stands: the organisation `example_org` has an underscore, which no GitHub
# account can have, and every host is on example.com, so the placeholders cannot be someone's real ones.
#
# This is the "shared" form of the manifest: there are no model files and no meaning file in your repository.
# The model and the meaning graph are published in github.com/datatug/chinookdb, and are named by address,
# each pinned with ?ref=<40 hex> to the commit that is read. Every hoster of Chinook points at the same two
# addresses, so every one of them is a database of the same model.
#
# Offline check:   node scripts/check-ovdb-manifest.mjs --repository https://github.com/example_org/chinook-hosting <directory>
# (it checks the shape only; the Directory checks the addresses against the ModelSpec and MeaningGraph registries.)
format: ovdb-manifest/draft-1

# PLACEHOLDER: your id. Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens; it names your Directory record.
id: chinook-example
# PLACEHOLDER: what the Directory shows.
title: Chinook at Example Co
description: >-
  The Chinook sample database, hosted by Example Co.

# PLACEHOLDER: optional. Your own page for the database, published in the Directory's index. An https URL of at most 200 characters, lower-case host, plain path (A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ / -), no port.
homepage: https://example.com/chinook/

# PLACEHOLDER: the canonical identity of your database, a public https URL with `ovdb` as a path segment or
# as a subdomain. It stays the same if the deployment moves.
url: https://ovdb.example.com/dbs/chinook

deployment:
  # PLACEHOLDER: where your database is live.
  url: https://cloud.example.com/ovdb/dbs/chinook
  # PLACEHOLDER: the engine your deployment runs.
  engine: postgres
  # PLACEHOLDER: the discovery document on the origin of the canonical url above, always at this path.
  discovery: https://ovdb.example.com/.well-known/openvaultdb
  # PLACEHOLDER: where a recordset's page is; {name} stands for the recordset's name.
  recordset_page: https://cloud.example.com/ovdb/dbs/chinook/collections/{name}

# The shared model, pinned. 8c9e62e is the commit of datatug/chinookdb that the ModelSpec registry, the
# MeaningGraph registry and the Directory all pin today. No local model files, so no model.modelspec or
# model.hcl; the registry says where the model's files are.
model:
  address: modelspec://github.com/datatug/chinookdb/chinook?ref=8c9e62ed6641c0a00faa3867167d928af4c44b06

meaning:
  # The shared meaning graph, pinned the same way.
  address: meaning://github.com/datatug/chinookdb?ref=8c9e62ed6641c0a00faa3867167d928af4c44b06
  # A path in the graph's repository (datatug/chinookdb), not in yours: the meaning file that binds the model.
  file: model/chinook.meaning.yaml
  graph:
    # The MeaningGraph registry's id for that graph.
    id: chinook

# PLACEHOLDER: you, the publisher. The repository is the one that carries this file, on github.com. (An
# organisation name with an underscore is not a name GitHub can issue: replace it with yours.)
publisher:
  name: Example Co
  url: https://github.com/example_org
  repository: https://github.com/example_org/chinook-hosting

# licences.data is the licence of the data you serve, and the one the Directory shows for your database. The
# upstream Chinook data (Copyright (c) 2008-2024 Luis Rocha) is MIT; change it only if your copy is different.
# licences.model and licences.meaning are left out: the registries say what the model and the meaning are
# licensed under (if you write them, they must agree).
licences:
  data: MIT

# Exactly the entities of the Chinook model, which are also the collection names your deployment serves.
# To serve a subset, list it and add `recordsets_partial: true` (a subset must also list every entity that a
# listed entity references).
recordsets:
  - Album
  - Artist
  - Customer
  - Employee
  - Genre
  - Invoice
  - InvoiceLine
  - MediaType
  - Playlist
  - PlaylistTrack
  - Track

# OpenVaultDB publisher manifest

This repository publishes the Chinook sample database to the
[OpenVaultDB](https://github.com/openvaultdb) Directory.

The list above names the manifest files the Directory may read. It is an
explicit list of paths relative to the repository root, never a glob, so only
files named here are published.
[`ovdb.yaml`](ovdb.yaml) describes one database: its canonical identity, the
live deployment, the ModelSpec model, the MeaningGraph meaning file, the
publisher and the licences.

An optional top-level `homepage` is the publisher's own page for the database,
an https URL of at most 200 characters; the Directory publishes it in its index, and its site may show it as "Website".

A manifest names its ModelSpec model in one of two ways: by local files
(`model.modelspec` and `model.hcl`), or, when the model lives in another
repository, by `model.address` pinned with `?ref=<40 hex>` and no local files
(the Directory accepts both forms; see [`examples/hoster/`](examples/hoster/)).
This repository carries its own files and the model's address,
`modelspec://github.com/datatug/chinookdb/chinook`, registered in the ModelSpec
registry, with no ref because the files are in the same repository. The
manifest format is a draft (`ovdb-manifest/draft-1`).

# OpenVaultDB publisher manifest for the Chinook sample database.
# Format: draft. Every path below is relative to the repository root (this file is there too)
# and must be a regular file tracked by git. No secrets belong here.
format: ovdb-manifest/draft-1
id: chinook
title: Chinook music store
description: >-
  The Chinook sample database: a digital music store with artists, albums,
  tracks, playlists, customers, employees and invoices. Read-only, served from
  a pinned copy of the upstream SQLite fixture.

# The publisher's own page for the database: the Directory publishes it in its index, and its site may show it as "Website".
homepage: https://chinookdb.com/

# The canonical identity of the database. It stays the same if the deployment moves.
url: https://chinookdb.com/ovdb/dbs/chinook

deployment:
  url: https://cloud.openvaultdb.com/ovdb/dbs/chinook
  engine: sqlite
  # The discovery document at the origin of the canonical url; it lists that url.
  discovery: https://chinookdb.com/.well-known/openvaultdb
  # Where a recordset's page is. Clients use this template and never build the route themselves.
  recordset_page: https://cloud.openvaultdb.com/ovdb/dbs/chinook/collections/{name}

# The model is named by local files (below), as here, or, when it lives in another repository, by `address`
# pinned with ?ref=<40 hex> and no local files (the shared form, see examples/hoster/); the Directory accepts
# both. This repository has its files, and also the model's address in the ModelSpec registry
# (github.com/modelspec-org/registry, where `chinook` is registered), which the Directory copies into its
# index. The address is repository + module name; it has no ref because the files are in this same repository.
model:
  address: modelspec://github.com/datatug/chinookdb/chinook
  modelspec: model/chinook.modelspec.json
  hcl: model/chinook.modelspec.hcl

meaning:
  file: model/chinook.meaning.yaml
  # Registered as `chinook` in github.com/meaninggraph/registry.
  graph:
    id: chinook
    address: meaning://github.com/datatug/chinookdb

publisher:
  name: DataTug
  url: https://github.com/datatug
  repository: https://github.com/datatug/chinookdb

# licences.data is the licence the Directory shows for the database: the data is the upstream
# Chinook data (Copyright (c) 2008-2024 Luis Rocha), MIT. The model and the meaning file are
# this repository's own work.
licences:
  data: MIT
  model: MIT
  meaning: CC0-1.0

# Recordset names are the ModelSpec entity names, which are also the collection
# names the deployment serves.
recordsets:
  - Album
  - Artist
  - Customer
  - Employee
  - Genre
  - Invoice
  - InvoiceLine
  - MediaType
  - Playlist
  - PlaylistTrack
  - Track

ops:
format: meaning/draft-1
id: chinook
name: Chinook music store
description: >-
  What the Chinook sample database means: a digital music store that sells
  tracks to customers in 24 countries. Each concept says what it is, the words
  people use for it, and which ModelSpec entity or property holds it, in which
  role. Concepts that are not specific to Chinook (country, currency,
  customer, invoice, price, revenue, date, population, per capita) are reused
  from the universal concepts at meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core, each
  reference pinned to one commit with ?ref=.
license: CC0-1.0
models:
  chinook: chinook.modelspec.hcl
sources:
  - id: world-bank-population
    provider: World Bank
    dataset: SP.POP.TOTL
    title: Population, total (World Development Indicators)
    year: 2025
    license: CC-BY-4.0
    url: https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL
    note: >-
      Not part of Chinook. The latest observation per country. As of
      github.com/datatug/chinook-demo commit d2fc437 (data/geo/population_wb),
      the snapshot the DataTug Chinook demo uses, it is 2025 for all 24
      Chinook countries.

concepts:
  # The catalogue

  - id: artist
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Artist
      ru: Исполнитель
    synonyms:
      en: [band, musician, performer, singer, group, act]
      ru: [артист, группа, музыкант]
    description: A recording artist or band, known by its name.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        property: ArtistId
        role: identifier
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Artist
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        property: ArtistId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The artist of an album.

  - id: album
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Album
      ru: Альбом
    synonyms:
      en: [record, release, LP]
      ru: [пластинка, релиз]
    description: An album by one artist, known by its title.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Album
        property: Title
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: AlbumId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The album a track is on (the column allows none; every track in this data has one).

  - id: track
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Track
      ru: Трек
    synonyms:
      en: [song, tune, recording, piece of music, video]
      ru: [песня, композиция, запись]
    description: One audio or video track that the store sells, usually on an album.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: TrackId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The track bought on an invoice line.

  - id: track-length
    kind: attribute
    of: track
    labels:
      en: Track length
      ru: Длительность трека
    synonyms:
      en: [duration, length, running time, how long]
      ru: [длительность, продолжительность]
    description: How long a track plays.
    unit: milliseconds
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: Milliseconds
        role: value

  - id: list-price
    kind: attribute
    of: track
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/price?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: List price
      ru: Цена трека
    synonyms:
      en: [track price, price of a track, how much a track costs]
    description: >-
      The price of one copy of a track in the catalogue (0.99 or 1.99). The
      price actually charged is on the invoice line (see unit-price).
    unit: USD
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: UnitPrice
        role: value

  - id: genre
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Genre
      ru: Жанр
    synonyms:
      en: [style, music style, kind of music, category]
      ru: [стиль, направление]
    description: A music genre such as Rock or Jazz, assigned to tracks.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Genre
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Genre
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: GenreId
        role: foreign-key
        note: A track's genre.

  - id: media-type
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Media type
      ru: Формат файла
    synonyms:
      en: [format, file format, file type, encoding, audio format]
      ru: [формат, тип файла]
    description: The file format of a track, such as "MPEG audio file" or "Protected AAC audio file".
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.MediaType
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.MediaType
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Track
        property: MediaTypeId
        role: foreign-key
        note: A track's media type.

  - id: playlist
    kind: entity
    labels:
      en: Playlist
      ru: Плейлист
    synonyms:
      en: [play list, collection, mix]
      ru: [подборка, список воспроизведения]
    description: >-
      A named list of tracks. A track can be on many playlists and a playlist
      holds many tracks; PlaylistTrack records which track is on which list.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Playlist
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Playlist
        property: Name
        role: display-name
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.PlaylistTrack
        property: PlaylistId
        role: foreign-key
        note: Playlist membership, one row per track on a playlist.

  # People

  - id: customer
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/customer?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Customer
      ru: Клиент
    description: A person who buys music from the store. Some customers name a company.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: CustomerId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The customer who made a purchase.

  - id: customer-country
    kind: attribute
    of: customer
    values-of: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Customer country
      ru: Страна клиента
    synonyms:
      en: [where customers live, customer's country, home country]
      ru: [страна проживания]
    description: >-
      The country in the customer's address, as Chinook spells it ("USA",
      "Czech Republic"). For questions about where music is bought, use
      billing-country instead.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        property: Country
        role: value

  - id: employee
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/employee?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Employee
      ru: Сотрудник
    description: A member of the store's staff. Employee.Title is the job title.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Employee
        role: entity

  - id: manager
    kind: attribute
    of: employee
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/manager?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    values-of: employee
    labels:
      en: Manager
      ru: Руководитель
    description: The employee someone reports to. Empty for the general manager.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Employee
        property: ReportsTo
        role: foreign-key

  - id: support-rep
    kind: attribute
    of: customer
    values-of: employee
    labels:
      en: Support representative
      ru: Специалист поддержки
    synonyms:
      en: [support rep, sales support agent, account manager, rep]
      ru: [менеджер клиента, сотрудник поддержки]
    description: The employee who looks after a customer.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Customer
        property: SupportRepId
        role: foreign-key

  # Sales

  - id: invoice
    kind: entity
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/invoice?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Invoice
      ru: Счёт
    synonyms:
      en: [purchase, sale, order]
      ru: [покупка, заказ]
    description: >-
      One purchase by a customer: in Chinook every invoice is a completed
      order, so "purchase" and "order" name it too. Chinook has 412 invoices
      dated from 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-22.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        role: entity
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.InvoiceLine
        property: InvoiceId
        role: foreign-key
        note: The invoice a line is on.

  - id: invoice-date
    kind: dimension
    of: invoice
    extends: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/date?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Invoice date
      ru: Дата счёта
    synonyms:
      en: [purchase date, when, year, month, sale date]
      ru: [дата покупки, год, месяц]
    description: The date of a purchase. The time part is always midnight.
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: InvoiceDate
        role: value

  - id: billing-country
    kind: dimension
    of: invoice
    values-of: meaning://github.com/meaninggraph/core/country?ref=cb97dbcd9e951b00e7d46cb2e0c4e120c24c8db7
    labels:
      en: Country
      ru: Страна
    synonyms:
      en: [billing country, country of purchase, where music is bought, buying country]
      ru: [страна покупки, страна покупателя]
    description: >-
      The country an invoice is billed to, as Chinook spells it ("USA",
      "Czech Republic"). Use this one when a question asks which countries buy
      or spend: it is recorded on the sale itself, and it is the column the
      saved per-capita query groups by. In this data it equals the customer's
      country on every invoice, but it would stay right if a customer moved.
      Chinook's spellings are matched to countries by the labels and aliases
      of the universal country concept ("USA" is an alias of United States).
    bindings:
      - model: modelspec:///chinook.Invoice
        property: BillingCountry
        role: value
        match: labels

  - id: invoice-line

# OpenVaultDB publisher manifest

This repository publishes the Chinook sample database to the
[OpenVaultDB](https://github.com/openvaultdb) Directory.

The list above names the manifest files the Directory may read. It is an
explicit list of paths relative to the repository root, never a glob, so only
files named here are published.
[`ovdb.yaml`](ovdb.yaml) describes one database: its canonical identity, the
live deployment, the ModelSpec model, the MeaningGraph meaning file, the
publisher and the licences.

An optional top-level `homepage` is the publisher's own page for the database,
an https URL of at most 200 characters; the Directory publishes it in its index, and its site may show it as "Website".

A manifest names its ModelSpec model in one of two ways: by local files
(`model.modelspec` and `model.hcl`), or, when the model lives in another
repository, by `model.address` pinned with `?ref=<40 hex>` and no local files
(the Directory accepts both forms; see [`examples/hoster/`](examples/hoster/)).
This repository carries its own files and the model's address,
`modelspec://github.com/datatug/chinookdb/chinook`, registered in the ModelSpec
registry, with no ref because the files are in the same repository. The
manifest format is a draft (`ovdb-manifest/draft-1`).
